dependency_evidence: SV2-GAT-03 merged into dev as pull request 7586; this package binds a consultation receipt to the delivery that path already records and checks it on covered writes.
evidence_class: mocked: fixture cases run in a temporary agentihooks home and a temporary SQLite ledger with the brain refresh and project retrieval patched to return the fixture packs; no live agent session runs the gate yet
interfaces: scripts.gates.brain.bind(task, row, brain) returns the binding: purpose task, the task id, the sha256 of the task title, description, plan slice, plan lines and phase, the claim generation and the brain id; a state, claimant or pull request change keeps the revision

scripts.gates.brain.check(receipt, current, now) returns the first reason a receipt fails: missing, another purpose, another task, an older claim generation, an older spec revision, another brain, expired, or a result other than delivered or empty; it returns nothing for a valid receipt, a valid empty result included

scripts.gates.brain.BrainGate, registered as the gate named brain in scripts.gates.entry, matches only Edit, Write, MultiEdit, NotebookEdit and Serena edit calls, passes every session not bound to a swarm task, refuses when the task spec cannot be read, and never queries the brain; its default mode is observe (log only) and enforce (deny) is the required mode

hooks.context.task_context.offer writes, beside the delivery receipt, a consultation receipt bound to the session's current task binding with a result of delivered, empty or failed, the pack digest and an expiry of AGENTIHOOKS_BRAIN_RECEIPT_TTL seconds (default 14400); an unchanged pack is deduplicated only while that receipt still passes check, so a spec change, a new claim, a brain change, expiry or a failed result redelivers the pack at the next refresh
hooks.context.task_context.classify reads the rendered pack by line: the stale project memory line marks a brain failure, the exact no project memory line marks a valid empty result

supported_versions.targets: Claude edit tool names and Serena edit tools; Codex apply_patch is not matched

states.observed: The fixture cases A, B and C passed in the focused Proofs run https://github.com/the-cloud-clockwork/agentihooks/actions/runs/40417667842 at df5f12feb68aad912e50fc5fa94467d707fa876e (2824 passed); they failed before the change in https://github.com/the-cloud-clockwork/agentihooks/actions/runs/40415890504 at 4c0aa46eb.
states.accepted: A consultation is accepted when offer delivers a pack to a session bound to a swarm task; the consultation receipt is written in the same call.
states.committed: The consultation receipt file under the agentihooks home brain state folder, namespaced by installation and brain, and gate log rows in the swarm gate log are the only writes.
states.externally_verified: None: no role condition attaches the gate to agent sessions yet, so no live session has been gated; that belongs to the G6 rollout gate.

brain_gate_false_block_rate.label: mocked
brain_gate_false_block_rate.definition: covered writes refused while the session held a receipt that check accepts, over covered writes made with such a receipt, across the fixture cases

rollback_rehearsal.action: agentihooks swarm <swarm> set "brain-gate=log only" returns the gate to observe mode.
rollback_rehearsal.authoritative_objects: The ledger task row and the brain's project memory are authoritative and untouched; consultation receipts and gate log rows are history and are kept.
rollback_rehearsal.proof: test_b_rollback_to_observe_keeps_the_receipt_and_the_gate_log refuses a covered write in enforce mode, lets it through in observe mode, and keeps both gate log rows and the receipt.

remaining_limitations: No role condition runs the gate yet; writing condition files needs an operator request, filed as a ledger follow up.

The receipt is an unsigned record in the session's hook state; the gate guides an agent and is no security boundary against one that controls its own files, as Swarm v2 section 11.3 accepts; signing is filed as a follow up.
The receipt does not yet bind project id, policy version, knowledge revision or selected evidence; filed as a follow up.
Refresh on entering a governed subsystem or on a repeated error pattern, and ledger page visibility of gate results, are filed as follow ups; outcome recording belongs to SV2-GAT-05.
A stale receipt is renewed at the next brain refresh, every BRAIN_REFRESH_TOOL_CALLS tool calls, so a required mode gate refuses covered writes until then.
compatibility: Sessions not bound to a swarm task deliver and deduplicate packs exactly as in SV2-GAT-03 and write no consultation receipt; inside a task the pack is redelivered only when the consultation no longer passes.
authority: The binding comes from the ledger task row named by the session's swarm and task variables and the session's brain id; a receipt for another task, purpose or brain never satisfies the gate.
